I'm looking at the doctor diagnostic output showing three errors related to authentication readiness. The first two are documented in the installation summary—the ready_failed issue stems from missing keycloak configuration, and auth_login_failed involves an unexpected builder mock login redirect to the dev login route.

The third error is auth_me_failed, where the endpoint returns a 401 instead of the expected mock user response. The installer notes this appears to be a mismatch between the repo's smoke test contract and what the app actually implements—the current version uses a different auth flow (`/?auth=dev-login`) and doesn't include a `name` field in the session user object.

Now I need to dig into whether this is genuinely a contract drift issue in the repo or something else. I should check what the smoke test expects for the local-builder profile, examine the actual auth implementation in the app, and test the real auth flow end-to-end to see if users can actually log in and get their session data.
